title: First run: nothing chosen
check: No provider is preselected. Save is disabled. The wording says the key stays on this computer.

title: Anthropic chosen
check: A note says Anthropic cannot make images. The image menu offers only Gemini and OpenAI. Save is disabled.

title: Anthropic with a key, no image source yet
check: The key shows as dots. Save is still disabled until an image provider is chosen.

title: Anthropic for text, OpenAI for images
check: A second key field appears for the image provider. Save is enabled.

title: Gemini for everything
check: Images default to the same provider, no second key field, Save is enabled.

title: Main window: nothing chosen yet
check: Calm and empty. The provider chip says Choose an AI provider; Make video is greyed out; the hint explains the offline demo.

title: Main window: a story written, a provider chosen
check: The chip shows both providers. Make video is dark and enabled. The hint explains what will happen.

title: Main window: working
check: A heading says what is happening, a thin progress line grows, each shot shows its own state with a coloured dot, and Cancel is available.

title: Main window: something went wrong
check: A plain sentence says what failed (in red), and a button takes you back to your story, which is kept.

title: Main window: the finished offline demo
check: A still from the video, its length and size, and Play, Show in folder and Save a copy. This one was made for real by the offline demo.

title: Main window: dark theme
check: The same window in dark: readable text, the accent colour lifted, nothing washed out.
